title: Neon Plasma Armory Clean Alpha and Glass Shield Review

items.name: Energy Pickup
items.collection_description: A compact cyan plasma collection burst expanding from a brilliant central point with short violet fragments and generous transparent padding.

items.name: Plasma Grenade
items.detonation_description: A compact high-energy plasma detonation that reads as the natural destructive release of the grenade's cyan core, with a tight brilliant center and short irregular energy spikes.

items.name: Plasma Shield
items.impact_description: One isolated compact shield-hit reaction with branching pale-blue glass-like fractures, a bright cyan contact flare, and restrained violet stress energy; effect fragments only, not a complete shield.
items.break_description: One isolated circular scattering pattern of cyan honeycomb force-field fragments and restrained violet energy shards, leaving an empty transparent center and clearly reading as a protective field breaking apart.
